description: A bachelor party for 8 people. Conflict: Half the group wants a 'luxury' experience (high budget), while the other half are students/entry-level (low budget). The user needs to find a destination and itinerary that offers 'splurge' options alongside 'budget' essentials.

user_profile.context: Group chat is arguing about costs
user_profile.communication_style: Mediator, trying to be fair and transparent

fact_sheet.fact: The bachelor party is for groom-to-be Alex Miller.
The group consists of 8 attendees in total.
The best man and trip planner is Sam Jones, age 27.
The 'Luxury' faction, preferring high-end options, includes attendees Leo, Mark, Chris, and David.
The 'Budget' faction, preferring low-cost options, includes attendees Sam, Ben, Tom, and Josh.
The per-person budget target for the 'Budget' faction is $700.
The per-person budget target for the 'Luxury' faction is $2,000.
All shared expenses are being tracked using the PayShare app under the group name 'Alex's Porto Cayo Trip'.
Sam Jones collected a $250 deposit from each of the 8 attendees on June 10, 2024, to secure the accommodation.
The official group chat for planning is on Signal, titled 'Alex's Last Stand'.
A PollPal poll on June 5, 2024, resulted in a 5-3 vote for 'Porto Cayo' over 'Veridia City' as the destination.
The master itinerary and budget is in a Google Sheet named 'Alex's Bachelor Bash Planner'.
The proposed travel dates for the trip are Thursday, August 15, 2024, to Sunday, August 18, 2024.
The group will depart from Northwood City Airport (NWC).
The destination airport is Porto Cayo International (PCI).
The recommended budget flight is on 'AeroVista Air', flight AV451, costing $285 round-trip for a basic economy seat.
The 'Luxury' faction members have booked 'AeroVista Plus' seats on flight AV451 for $450, which includes priority boarding and one checked bag.
The group booked the 'Villa Solana', a 5-bedroom villa with a private pool in Porto Cayo.
The total cost for Villa Solana for 3 nights (Aug 15-18) is $2,000, which equates to $250 per person.
Villa Solana is located at 125 Mariposa Lane, Porto Cayo, and the booking reference is #VS-884G1.
The entire group has agreed to a 4-hour hike on the Mount Sol Trail on Friday, August 16th, which has no entry fee.
A group dinner is planned for the first night (Aug 15th) at 'El Faro Taqueria', with an estimated cost of $30 per person.
The 'Luxury' faction has booked a 4-hour private yacht trip with 'Cayo Charters' for Saturday, August 17th, at a cost of $400 per person for the four of them.
A dinner reservation for four has been made at 'The Gilded Cut' steakhouse on Saturday, August 17th, at 9:00 PM, with an estimated cost of $250 per person.
The 'Luxury' faction purchased VIP table service at 'Club Nebula' for Friday night for $1,200 total ($300 per person).
The 'Budget' faction plans to visit the public beach, Playa Dorada, on Saturday, August 17th, which is free to access.
The 'Budget' faction has booked a brewery tour and tasting at 'Porto Cayo Brewing Co.' for Friday afternoon for $25 per person.
While others are at the steakhouse, the 'Budget' faction will go on the 'Cayo Bites' street food tour for $45 per person on Saturday evening.
The initial proposal for a single group dinner at 'The Gilded Cut' was rejected due to the $250 per person cost, leading to the split dinner plan.
Sam Jones created two separate optional activity tracks ('Splurge' and 'Saver') in the planning spreadsheet to provide transparency on costs.
On June 12, 2024, Sam posted a summary in the group chat confirming the locked-in shared costs (flight base, villa) totaled $535 per person.
